trans-unit.source: Mr. Lester... I wonder what he's like.
trans-unit.target: Mr. Lester... I wonder what he's like.

trans-unit.source: Mr. Lenios said something about him being “a little eccentric.”
trans-unit.target: Mr. Lenios said something about him being “a little eccentric.”

trans-unit.source: I...don't know if I like the sound of that.
trans-unit.target: I...don't know if I like the sound of that.

trans-unit.source: I'm sure we'll have nothing to worry about if we speak in good faith.
trans-unit.target: I'm sure we'll have nothing to worry about if we speak in good faith.

trans-unit.source: I guess that sounds reasonable. Okay, then! On to Euclid Village!
